findings.summary: The assertion `options.model_dump(by_alias=True) | settings == options.model_dump(by_alias=True)` compares the parsed options against the very settings dict the test itself supplied, so it holds by construction once validation succeeded and cannot redden on a value-handling regression that keeps validation green. The independent expectation is the literal in the same parametrize table at line 39 (`options.call_kwargs() == expected`).

The assertion `record["messages"][0][0]["content"] == fit_enrichment_prompt(render_prompt("signals/enrichment"))` puts the same function applied to the same input on both sides, so it survives a regression that makes fit_enrichment_prompt return its baseline unchanged; only the wiring half of the guard (the worker stops calling fit at all) is covered here, and the content half rests on the separate literal assertions at lines 67-75.

The brief's second declared control (brief.md:89-90: removing the schema constraint from the best combination lowers its measured raw parse rate) is reported falsified rather than demonstrated: the selected arm is already constraint-free and the measured direction is opposite (combination-one 177/200 = 88.5% raw with the constraint versus combination-one-without-schema 197/200 = 98.5% without, private/refinement-summary.json). The record states the falsification plainly at manifest.md:20 and substitutes the schema/JSON-mode forwarding mutation as its red control.
